items.title: [gh-modernization F0] Bootstrap and independently qualify FS.GG.Coordination v2

items.title: [epic] Quint-first Typed SDD migration
items.reason: The epic still owns an ordered program with open consumer, retirement and decision outcomes.
items.remainingOutcome: Complete the remaining producer/consumer adoption, retirement and default-decision sequence.

items.title: [cross-repo] Q6: project the published Quint backend into the registry and workspace UI
items.reason: Its producer dependency is closed, but the owning design requires Q5 acceptance before Q6 and that V2 outcome remains open.
items.remainingOutcome: Adopt the published Quint backend in registry and workspace UI with coherent feed and clean-workspace proof.

items.title: [cross-repo] Q7: retire F# as a supported Typed SDD authoring path
items.reason: The retirement outcome remains explicitly conditional on unfinished adoption and soak evidence.
items.remainingOutcome: Retire new F# authoring only after all selected consumers adopt Quint and the soak requirement is met.

items.title: [decision] Q7: decide whether Quint-backed Typed SDD becomes the workspace default
items.reason: The owning roadmap deliberately keeps the default choice separate and selected after retirement evidence.
items.remainingOutcome: Record the evidence-based accept, defer or reject decision after retirement and soak evidence.

items.title: [cross-repo] Add read-only planning, trace, and operations projections to Coordination v2
items.reason: This is a distinct retained read-only projection outcome in the V2 product repository.
items.remainingOutcome: Deliver the shared read-only planning, trace, risk and operations projection after the prerequisite V2 model contracts.
